Bill.BriefDescription: Revising the interest rate applied to legal financial obligations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to legal financial obligations; and amending RCW10.82.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 10.82.090 and 1995 c 291 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Financial obligations imposed in a judgment for an offensecommitted on or after the effective date of this act shall bearinterest from the date of the judgment until payment, at the rate((applicable to civil judgments)) of four percent. (2) Financial obligations imposed in a judgment for an offensecommitted prior to the effective date of this act shall bear interestfrom the effective date of this act until payment, at the rate of fourpercent. Nothing in this subsection shall affect any interest accruedon the obligations at a rate other than four percent prior to theeffective date of this act. (3) All nonrestitution interest retained by the court shall besplit twentyfive percent to the state treasurer for deposit in thepublic safety and education account as provided in RCW 43.08.250,twentyfive percent to the state treasurer for deposit in the judicial p. 1 HB 1836information system account as provided in RCW 2.68.020, twentyfivepercent to the county current expense fund, and twentyfive percent tothe county current expense fund to fund local courts.
